amendment_policy: After outcome inspection, changed protocol requires a new version and preserves previous trials/source exposure; a new directory or retry never resets work or creates confirmation.

budgets.capacity_disposition: resource_limited with completed-prefix counters and unavailable terminal scores; no budget extension or dropped cell
budgets.checkpoint_capture: Complete initial, midpoint and final checkpoints per actualcase plus every emitted-state digest; totalartifactcap includes traces/checkpoints/retries.
budgets.cost_matching: same inputs/order/caps per family; up to4 tried settings each. Fixed and parameter-free routes spend fewer actual trials, never duplicate to inflate evidence. Record actual work beside equal ceilings.
budgets.timing_policy: Three matched-order repetitions replay exact same workload; count all physical attempts and elapsed/CPU/RSS/source/state bytes. They are not new evidence units. No extra tuning from repetitions. Full driver, construction, validation and serialization are included; oracle cost measured separately.
budgets.work_accounting: Global panel-call cap includes attempted observations and failures across every physical process; acceptedU is recorded separately and is not a physical-work total. No cap resets after failure.

execution_amendment.preserved: All48rational panel arrays/17configurations, original ordering/selection equation/tie rules,3physical repetitions,15family+1oracle process attempts,77,112calls and every original wall/memory/byte cap are unchanged.
execution_amendment.protected_boundary: A genuinely protected source must still freeze the choice BEFORE evaluation execution; this amendment does not modify COLEMAN protected-evaluation contracts.
execution_amendment.provenance: Locally frozen authored protocol with exact hashes and independent pre-run review; not yet published, not authenticated public preregistration, source authentication or protected/unseen evidence. V1 wording about publication is historical prospective narrative, not an achieved publication claim.
execution_amendment.reason: V1 asks cross-family selection before evaluation execution but fixes one sequential complete48-case child per family and exactly15launches. Splitting/replaying development would violate the original process/work budgets.
execution_amendment.scope: Only the already known_exposed authored study may execute all fixed independent owners before selection. A typed development-only projection freezes all family winners before any evaluation-field inspection/reporting. No evaluation values/statuses tune, exclude or retune a family. Missing development evidence means unavailable choice, not a reduced family set.

families.recurrence: p_t proportional to prior*exp(-c*sqrt(log(3)/(U+1))*cumulative_accepted_loss); never historical-rate products

families.input_precision: Exactly the same once-converted binary64 losses as shipped reference learners; trailing totals are exact Fraction sums over those values, not raw rational source values.
families.recurrence: start uniform; after each8 available rows choose all exact minimum trailing-sum experts uniformly; hold until next refit; never future rows
p_t=(1/3,1/3,1/3); no tuning or invented repeated trials

gate.candidate_cost_ceiling: one additional untuned configuration, same64panels/512MiB/180s-family caps; report actual primitive/serialization work and wall/CPU separately, flag cost_limited rather than hiding overhead
gate.entry_rule: Retain/defer unless the development-selected deployable baseline exceeds the retrospective best of already-budgeted reference configurations by more than1/64 mean loss on at least2 distinct primary shapes, averaging rotations within shape. Never count rotations as separate confirmations; tracking-only failure cannot admit a rate method.
gate.future_acceptance: Independent arithmetic/state/delay refusals/recovery and actual matched costs first. Finite descriptive improvement must exceed1/64 on at least2 primary shapes with no safety-shape harm above1/64 and no extra tuning budget. Otherwise retain baseline; cannot imply empirical benefit.
gate.next_formulation_if_entry_supported: At most one public loss-dependent-rate proposal: uniform-prior AdaHedge2014 equations8and9, pending accepted mathematical/numerical/state/capability plan; no implementation selected by this artifact.
gate.unsupported_cases: No new tracking/share/specialist wrapper; no controls/delay/batching combination on prospective AdaHedge until separately specified and qualified.

activity_probe.active_missing_feedback: unavailable is not inactivity and prevents complete update
activity_probe.expected_current_reference: unsupported; never supply fabricated zero losses
activity_probe.future_specialist_gate: must separately declare awake-only comparator denominator, all-inactive abstention/no eligible learner update, reentry latent state and D/U/maturity clocks before any implementation

independent_checks.agreement: accepted weights abs<=2e-14 +relative<=2e-13; complete state roundtrip/digest exact within same declaredruntime; numerical_failure is a valid explicit mismatch disposition, not accepted approximate output.
independent_checks.ambiguous_threshold: insufficient_evidence; retain original quantities and numerical error, never force gate acceptance

extreme_rate_probe.expected: explicit positive_underflow/numeric refusal with unchanged entire state, outside tuning/effect family

metamorphic: common per-row translations leave reference coefficient paths unchanged where all shifted losses remain[0,1]
constant Hedge retains coefficient path under insertion of equal-loss rows after removing inserted indices; anytime Uclock need not
cyclic expert renaming permutes weights and preserves scores
future-row changes cannot affect earlier outputs
alpha0 reduction outside tuning as qualification-only
singleton and eta0 endpoints outside tuning as qualification-only
independent_checks.reference_oracle: Independent Decimal precision80 scalar exp and explicit3x3 share matrix; separate Fraction oracle for mixture scores, periodic baseline and exhaustive0/1-switch paths; do not call production math helpers for expected values.
independent_checks.score_arithmetic: Exact Fraction sums over actual emitted binary64 weights and supplied binary64 losses, then one final projection; retain residual, no score normalization.

metrics.meaning: mean mixture loss on informative suffix only
metrics.name: informative_mean_loss

metrics.meaning: mixture_loss minus min expert cumulative loss; may be negative
metrics.name: fixed_comparator_excess

metrics.meaning: mixture_loss minus exact retrospective best path with0or1 switch
metrics.name: one_switch_comparator_excess

metrics.meaning: full emitted coefficient L1, no fee interpretation
metrics.name: coefficient_L1

metrics.meaning: actual full process elapsed incl construction/validation/serialization
metrics.name: process_wall

metrics.meaning: actual process CPU, unavailable if not measured
metrics.name: process_cpu

metrics.meaning: actual lifetime process high-water, not allocation or per-learner peak
metrics.name: peak_rss

question: Do noninformative accepted panels and changing loss contrast leave practically material rate-selection fragility after matching the existing reference and periodic-baseline tuning budgets?
recovery_plan: Before any method qualification: real direct and installed traces, checkpoint after each selected prefix, same-runtime continuation, session duplicate delivery, interruption and actual concurrent writers through existing replay/state. Bare observe remains non-idempotent; no external effects in this protocol.

selection.all_trials: retain every17development and17evaluation configuration, including failures, unfavorable and unused settings; selected subsets do not erase family
selection.law: Within each family minimize equal-case mean of cumulative linear loss / actual_horizon on development only. Ties use declared configuration order. Select deployable baseline among family winners using same development score and declared family order. Freeze a typed development-only choice before any evaluation-field inspection/reporting. Every predeclared evaluation configuration executes unchanged with a fresh isolated owner; no evaluation-dependent tuning or family exclusion.
selection.protected_status: Evaluation role is already publicly exposed; no first-access/confirmatory claim. Any later truly protected source needs a new prospective freeze before access.
selection.retrospective_oracles: Best fixed expert and best path with at most1 switch reported separately, never deployed; best grid configuration per evaluation case is diagnostic only.
selection.zero_rate_conformance_pair: Constant eta0 and literal fixeduniform deliberately share coefficient behavior; compare actual work, never count as independent evidence or new adaptive methods.

semantics.accepted_update_clock: U increments once per accepted complete row; eta for next decision uses U+1
semantics.all_active_absence: unsupported-capability diagnostic only, not an efficacy case
semantics.availability_clock: complete row t becomes available after decision t, before t+1
semantics.batching: one row per update, no hidden reset
semantics.coefficient_movement: full L1 of emitted coefficients, unit1; not trade turnover or fee
semantics.decision_clock: D=t before row t is exposed
semantics.executed_charges: not_applicable; no funded book or external effects
semantics.informative_objective: same sum restricted to informative suffix / suffix_count
semantics.initialization: Fresh complete owner per case/configuration and physical repetition; uniform prior and D=U=0. No state transfer across cases or development/evaluation, no pooling. Global work/attempt caps never reset.
semantics.numerical_failure: retain complete prior state and U; record refusal and terminal unavailable metrics
semantics.stored_prior: three binary64 values1/3, normalized by existing emitted-fsum profile

source.independence: No independent empirical units; rotations and shapes are authored related checks, not replicates.

unavailable_rule: Null requires explicitstatus+reason; zero and valid negative excess remain observed. No completed aggregate unless every declared cell is present and validated.
